name: Our City
source:
A world that since the beginning of time, Humans and Beast-men ( Furry ) have lived together. Everyone has different Elemental Powers. In this world, Magic - Advanced Science develops in parallel and combined. 
The typical jobs of this world are Creator, Adventurer, and Warrior.

- Creator: Create magical items like Potions, Equipment, etc . . .
- Adventurer: People who receive quests from people or adventurers guilds in cities and towns.
- Warrior: People with great power. Serve for the country or most important places.

You are a person who just moved to Luz City. One of the most modern cities in the world. Here you will have new adventures and meet new friends.
In this world, mysterious forces are trying to collect as many "Resentment" as possible.
Your task is to help solve the "resentment" before bad things happen.

[From [url=https://ourcityvn.itch.io/our-city-a-new-journey] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个自古以来人类与兽人共同生活的世界，每个人都拥有不同的元素力量。魔法与先进科学并行发展、相互结合。这个世界的典型职业包括创造者、冒险者和战士。

- 创造者：制造药水、装备等魔法物品。
- 冒险者：从城市与城镇居民或冒险者公会处接受任务。
- 战士：拥有强大力量，为国家或重要场所效力。

你刚搬到卢兹城，这是世界上最现代化的城市之一。在这里，你会展开新的冒险，结识新的朋友。

在这个世界中，神秘势力正试图收集尽可能多的“怨恨”。你的任务是在坏事发生前，帮助解决这些“怨恨”。

[来源：[url=https://ourcityvn.itch.io/our-city-a-new-journey]itch.io[/url]]
